name: Sexverse
source:
Sexverse is created as a parody of a well known popular video game characters. Games such as The Last of Us, Resident Evil & Overwatch. Ever wondered what happens after that bar scene with Panam in Cyberpunk 2077? Or what would happen if you end up romancing Miranda in Mass Effect and sharing a bed? Now you can experience that.

[From [url=https://void-star.itch.io/sexverse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Sexverse》戏仿了许多知名电子游戏中的角色，涉及《最后生还者》《生化危机》《守望先锋》等作品。你是否想过，《赛博朋克2077》中与帕南在酒吧的那一幕之后，会发生什么？又或者，在《质量效应》中与米兰达坠入爱河、同床共枕，会是怎样的情景？现在，你可以亲自体验了。

[摘自[url=https://void-star.itch.io/sexverse]Itch.io[/url]]
